data.name: Nijah
data.gender_notes: Nijah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Najahah’, meaning ‘to escape’ or ‘to save’. In Islamic context, Nijah represents the idea of overcoming obstacles and achieving success through perseverance and determination. The name Nijah carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nijah usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual victory and triumph over inner struggles.
data.etymology: Nijah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nijah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
